rows.quote: In the event that a variation is agreed upon, the marketing authorisation holder shall submit to the national competent authorities an appropriate application for a variation, including an updated summary of product characteristics and package leaflet within the determined timetable for implementation.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against the source; quote, statement, level and classification confirmed. Double-check: quote verbatim, statement within the quote, level follows the modal verb.

f.title: Member States must ensure biological medicinal products in suspected ADR reports are identified by name and batch number
f.statement: Member States shall ensure, through their methods for collecting information and, where necessary, through follow-up of suspected adverse reaction reports, that all appropriate measures are taken to clearly identify any biological medicinal product prescribed, dispensed or sold in their territory that is the subject of a suspected adverse reaction report, with due regard to the name of the medicinal product (Article 1(20)) and the batch number.
f.applicability: Biological medicinal products that are the subject of a suspected adverse reaction report
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.review_note: Added 2026-11-23 for the ICSR QC checks library. Duty on Member States; it drives the product name and batch number capture and follow-up that MAH QC checks verify.

f.title: Do not report ICSRs from the EMA-monitored literature for listed substances; monitor all other literature and report
f.statement: For medicinal products containing active substances on the list of publications monitored by the Agency under Article 27 of Regulation (EC) No 726/2004, marketing authorisation holders are not required to report to EudraVigilance the suspected adverse reactions recorded in the listed medical literature, but they shall monitor all other medical literature and report any suspected adverse reactions.
f.applicability: Medicinal products containing active substances on the EMA medical literature monitoring list
f.exceptions: Suspected adverse reactions recorded in the listed medical literature need not be reported by the MAH.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up; Submission operations

rows.quote: For medicinal products containing the active substances referred to in the list of publications monitored by the Agency pursuant to Article 27 of Regulation (EC) No 726/2004, marketing authorisation holders shall not be required to report to the Eudravigilance database the suspected adverse reactions recorded in the listed medical literature, but they shall monitor all other medical literature and report any suspected adverse reactions.
rows.review_note: Added 2026-11-23 for the ICSR QC checks library (MAH side of 726/2004 Art 27).

f.title: Inform the competent authority of the date of actual marketing in the Member State
f.statement: After a marketing authorisation has been granted, the marketing authorisation holder shall inform the competent authority of the authorising Member State of the date of actual marketing of the medicinal product for human use in that Member State, taking into account the various presentations authorised.

rows.quote: After a marketing authorisation has been granted, the holder of the authorisation shall inform the competent authority of the authorising Member State of the date of actual marketing of the medicinal product for human use in that Member State, taking into account the various presentations authorised.
rows.review_note: Added 2026-11-23 for the deliverable templates (template-gaps batch).

f.title: Notify the competent authority at least two months before marketing of the product ceases
f.statement: If the product ceases to be placed on the market of a Member State, temporarily or permanently, the marketing authorisation holder shall notify the competent authority of that Member State; other than in exceptional circumstances, the notification shall be made no less than two months before the interruption in the placing on the market.

rows.deadline: No less than two months before the interruption (other than in exceptional circumstances)
rows.quote: If the product ceases to be placed on the market of a Member State, either temporarily or permanently, the marketing authorisation holder shall notify the competent authority of that Member State. Such notification shall, other than in exceptional circumstances, be made no less than two months before the interruption in the placing on the market of the product.
rows.review_note: Added 2026-11-23 for the deliverable templates (template-gaps batch). Backward window: no deadline_rule. Core because the reasons feed the Art 123(2) safety declaration. SME review 2026-11-23: core_pv confirmed: the second paragraph of Art 23a was inserted by Directive 2012/26/EU (the post-Mediator pharmacovigilance amendment) together with Art 123(2)-(2b); it is the trigger for the safety-reason disclosure in 0042/0044-0047.

f.title: Give the competent authority the reasons for ceasing marketing, in line with Article 123(2)
f.statement: The marketing authorisation holder shall inform the competent authority of the reasons for ceasing to place the product on the market, in accordance with Article 123(2).

rows.quote: The marketing authorisation holder shall inform the competent authority of the reasons for such action in accordance with Article 123(2).
rows.review_note: Added 2026-11-23 for the deliverable templates (template-gaps batch).

f.title: Provide sales volume and prescription volume data to the competent authority on request
f.statement: Upon request by the competent authority, particularly in the context of pharmacovigilance, the marketing authorisation holder shall provide all data relating to the volume of sales of the medicinal product and any data in its possession relating to the volume of prescriptions.

rows.quote: Upon request by the competent authority, particularly in the context of pharmacovigilance, the marketing authorisation holder shall provide the competent authority with all data relating to the volume of sales of the medicinal product, and any data in his possession relating to the volume of prescriptions.
rows.review_note: Added 2026-11-23 for the deliverable templates (template-gaps batch).

f.title: Notify the Member States forthwith of suspension, withdrawal, MA withdrawal request or non-renewal, with reasons
f.statement: The marketing authorisation holder shall notify the Member States concerned forthwith of any action it takes to suspend the marketing of a medicinal product, to withdraw a medicinal product from the market, to request the withdrawal of a marketing authorisation or not to apply for its renewal, together with the reasons for such action.
f.processes: Submission operations; Benefit–risk review; Safety governance

rows.quote: The marketing authorisation holder shall be obliged to notify the Member States concerned forthwith of any action taken by the holder to suspend the marketing of a medicinal product, to withdraw a medicinal product from the market, to request the withdrawal of a marketing authorisation or not to apply for the renewal of a marketing authorisation, together with the reasons for such action.
rows.review_note: Added 2026-11-23 for the deliverable templates (template-gaps batch).

f.title: Declare whether the action is based on any of the grounds in Article 116 or 117(1)
f.statement: In that notification, the marketing authorisation holder shall in particular declare whether the action is based on any of the grounds set out in Article 116 or Article 117(1).

rows.quote: The marketing authorisation holder shall in particular declare if such action is based on any of the grounds set out in Article 116 or Article 117(1).
rows.review_note: Added 2026-11-23 for the deliverable templates (template-gaps batch). SME review 2026-11-23: title revised.

f.title: Also notify actions taken in a third country when based on Article 116 or 117(1) grounds
f.statement: The marketing authorisation holder shall also make the notification under Article 123(2) where the action is taken in a third country and is based on any of the grounds set out in Article 116 or Article 117(1).
f.applicability: Actions taken in a third country on Article 116 or 117(1) grounds

rows.quote: The marketing authorisation holder shall also make the notification pursuant to paragraph 2 of this Article in cases where the action is taken in a third country and where such action is based on any of the grounds set out in Article 116 or Article 117(1).
rows.review_note: Added 2026-11-23 for the deliverable templates (template-gaps batch).

f.title: Notify the Agency when the action is based on Article 116 or 117(1) grounds
f.statement: The marketing authorisation holder shall furthermore notify the Agency where the action referred to in Article 123(2) or (2a) is based on any of the grounds referred to in Article 116 or Article 117(1).
f.applicability: Actions under Article 123(2) or (2a) on Article 116 or 117(1) grounds

rows.quote: The marketing authorisation holder shall furthermore notify the Agency where the action referred to in paragraph 2 or 2a of this Article is based on any of the grounds referred to in Article 116 or Article 117(1).
rows.review_note: Added 2026-11-23 for the deliverable templates (template-gaps batch).
